content.title: Recommendations for management of ACS in cancer patients / long-term management & pharmacological treatment

antithrombotic_choice_and_dosage.recommendation: Adapt the choice and dosage of antithrombotic agent, as well as of secondary prevention medications, to renal function, co-medications, comorbidities, frailty, cognitive function, and specific contraindications.

frail_older_patients.recommendation: For frail older patients with comorbidities, a holistic approach is recommended to individualize interventional and pharmacological treatments after careful evaluation of the risks and benefits.

invasive_strategy_in_cancer_patients.recommendation: An invasive strategy is recommended in cancer patients presenting with high-risk ACS with expected life survival ≥6 months.

temporary_interruption_cancer_therapy.recommendation: A temporary interruption of cancer therapy is recommended in patients in whom the cancer therapy is suspected to be a contributing cause of ACS.

aspirin.recommendation: Aspirin is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <10 000/µL.

clopidogrel.recommendation: Clopidogrel is not recommended in cancer patients with a platelet count <30 000/µL.

prasugrel_or_ticagrelor.recommendation: In ACS patients with cancer and <50 000/µL platelet count, prasugrel or ticagrelor are not recommended.

cardiac_rehabilitation.recommendation: It is recommended that all ACS patients participate in a medically supervised, structured, comprehensive, multidisciplinary exercise-based cardiac rehabilitation and prevention programme.

healthy_lifestyle.recommendation: It is recommended that ACS patients adopt a healthy lifestyle, including stopping all smoking of tobacco; healthy diet (Mediterranean style); alcohol restriction; regular aerobic physical activity and resistance exercise; reduced sedentary time.

lipid_lowering_therapy.recommendation: It is recommended that high-dose statin therapy is initiated or continued as early as possible, regardless of initial LDL-C values.
